rules.title: Source of Income Discrimination Prohibition
rules.requirement: Landlords in Los Angeles cannot refuse to rent, renew, or continue renting to a tenant based on their source of income, including housing assistance payments like vouchers.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to any housing accommodation offered for rent in the City of Los Angeles.
rules.quoted_span: Based upon a person’s source of income, refuse to rent or lease, or to continue to rent or lease, a housing accommodation; refuse to enter into or renew a rental agreement, lease or housing assistance payment contract; refuse to execute any documents required to enter into or renew a rental agreement, lease or housing assistance payment contract; serve a notice of termination of tenancy; seek to terminate or terminate a tenancy; or otherwise deny or withhold, a housing accommodation or housing services or amenities.
